document_status: Prospective design only; not implementation approval, selected final correction, or proof of upstream cause.
scope: Read-only source/design follow-up; no source/test/repo writes, production queries, trading or financial changes.

root_supplied_actual_target.evidence_authority: Facts supplied by root as uniquely joined original with all identities true; worker did not query production or independently reread private originals.
root_supplied_actual_target.inference: Explicit active-window membership is established as child-side V1 exclusion input. Quiet-maker expiry, lost source, transport change, metadata change, REST error and queue timing remain upstream hypotheses.

smallest_useful_question: For each actual child first/last effective explicit_slug observation, identify exactly which producer status instance supplied that slug, whether the router added it, and when that same immutable event entered/exited the parent FIFO and was received/applied in the child.
semantic_contract: Leave pure learner/fair model, fingerprint, V1 protocol/history/state/counters/receipts/admission/horizon/save cadence unchanged; no relabel/backfill.

The existing g first four fields, gap_windows list content and order, both booleans, callback order, and parent event FIFO order stay exactly the same. No extra g event, no skipped/replaced/coalesced g, no prioritization over queued books/trades, and no changed producer eligibility predicate.

Metadata is never an input to cancellation, risk, orders, maker availability, labels, terms, forecast eligibility, child effective-time choice, drop counters or learner disable paths. Invalid/missing metadata means unknown observation only.

Preserve existing clock calls used by decisions and existing evaluation order. Additional observation clocks are separately named and never substituted for existing application clocks. Do not call fresh_books/maker computations again to reconstruct a reason.
Do not add metadata keys to status dicts delivered to existing live callbacks/heartbeats/persisted outputs; use a separate observation call-scope carrier or explicit separate observer callback.

Exact physical runtime invariance is impossible to promise: metadata construction, bytes, decoding and logging consume time/resources and can alter near-deadline timing or socket backpressure. Require deterministic logical equivalence under matched fake clocks plus measured latency/pressure bounds; do not claim every real-time decision identical under every schedule.

source_correlation_breaks.loss: Distinct invalidate-all, old-fresh book disappearance and maker membership disappearance collapse into the same explicit slug list; ws_status default reason does not distinguish all predicates.
WS gaps, source transport transition, metadata transition/failure, REST book/tape failure all become status gap_windows.
Router unions producer explicit slugs with all venue windows on per-adapter stream true-to-false, while trade_stream becomes any-venue aggregate.
Full status -> only slug tuple/two booleans. Status has no unique observation ID/producer occurrence. The event then enters an already bounded FIFO.
Frame seq/timestamp is not a per-status occurrence or producer ID; several g records can share a frame and identical flags. Existing child first/last diagnostic lacks per-record ordinal.

event_identity.parent_observer_instance: 24 lowercase hex chars, generated once per parent process; observational only
event_identity.producer_status_seq: nonnegative int<=2^63-1, increments per producer status publication in that process; new process/new epoch prevents reuse
event_identity.aggregate_status_seq: nonnegative int<=2^63-1, each router callback; preserves same producer identity through router; direct/uninstrumented callbacks use null
event_identity.link_epoch: nonnegative bounded counter changes on new child/link lifecycle; observational only
event_identity.record_ordinal: index in actual encoded items list, including w/k/m/o records; not g-only ordinal guessed before outcomes are inserted
event_identity.child_instance: existing child diagnostic instance/PID/source hash; parent->child identity externally joined via exact deployment/spawn evidence, or an init-only common kernel process birth identity if byte-identical-wire map option requires it

clocks.producer_status_at_wall: observed callback publication time; this is status occurrence, NOT exchange gap/expiry time
clocks.producer_status_at_mono: same-parent monotonic observation; optional unavailable if not captured
clocks.aggregate_received_at_mono: router/runner observer boundary, after existing invalidation/cancel work if preserving critical callback priority; label exact point
clocks.fifo_enqueued_at_mono: immediately adjacent to successful existing append; queued=false/null if original event dropped/notrunning
clocks.fifo_dequeued_at_mono: adjacent to actual original pop during encode; no speculative sampling at flush start
clocks.frame_stamp_wall: unchanged existing now sampled at _flush start; keep current meaning even if named parent_frame_sent_at in old diagnostic
clocks.frame_encode_started_mono: optional new observation; includes no earlier FIFO residence
clocks.socket_first_attempt_mono: optional, sampled adjacent to existing send; completion is null unless actually observed without extra sends
clocks.child_receive_wall: existing receive() clock after decode, not socket arrival
clocks.child_apply_wall: existing gap apply/effective clock, still authoritative for V1 admission
clocks.underlying_source_occurrence: null unless a distinct valid source event timestamp exists; never invent it from producer callback, frame stamp or book/trade ages

minimum_logical_schema.reason_flags: Fixed bitset preserving simultaneous observed branches; no single guessed root-cause string.
minimum_logical_schema.window_facts: For at most32 tracked KXBTC15M slugs<=128chars: booleans before/after member of existing ws_books/ws_maker sets and producer explicit gap set/router-added set; existing adapter stream flag; transport enum rest/ws/unknown; existing connected flag; finite sampled local/source book and last accepted trade ages; age_sample_at named separately. Facts are observed predicates, not proof of quiet market versus missing upstream trades.
minimum_logical_schema.aggregate_facts: Fixed bool flags aggregate_trade_stream,coinbase_connected,kalshi_adapter_stream; no arbitrary all-venue dict copies.
minimum_logical_schema.validation: Only exact primitive types; no bool-as-int clocks/counters; finite clocks within declared numeric range; nonnegative differences only when ordered. Missing, reversed, overflow, wrap or mismatched identity -> null/unknown, never clamp. Fixed lengths/counts/byte budget before accepting metadata; never reject valid g because metadata is malformed.

producer_carrier.preferred: Separate observation-only call-scope context (e.g. task/thread-local ContextVar with try/finally token reset) around existing synchronous callback chain, or an explicit separate optional observer callback. Preserve existing callback positional args/status dict exactly.
producer_carrier.why: A private extra status dict key would reach speeddesk._live_call(on_status,status) and possibly existing reports, violating strict unchanged-output scope.
producer_carrier.capture_point: Capture fixed reason bits at the branch that computed original gap, using already-computed sets/locals; at router add separate router_explicit/router_falling masks without replacing original status.
producer_carrier.constraints: No awaits, thread hops, I/O, logging or recomputation inside the carrier. Context absent in uninstrumented paths is normal unknown. Nested callbacks must restore prior context; asyncio task inheritance and thread isolation must be tested. Preserve before-await invalidation ordering at WS disconnect.

transport_options.name: Optional fifth g metadata payload
transport_options.fit: Smallest complete end-to-end link from exact producer status through existing FIFO to the child first/last observation, with one original queue entry and no second event transport.
transport_options.compatibility: Current child reads only record[1:4] and ignores trailing fields, so an older child ignores the optional fifth field. New child accepts original4-field form. This is still a wire-shape extension requiring explicit separate scope/review; first-four-field semantics remain V1.
transport_options.implementation_boundary: Copy fixed immutable metadata once into the existing g item at append; at actual encode annotate only observation-specific dequeue/frame facts without changing original event order. Child validates/sanitizes metadata in an isolated guard, attaches it to private inbox observation context, and invokes unchanged learner gap with the same existing apply clock/args. Never change calls to gap/degrade or route producer occurrence into learner time.
transport_options.bounds: Proposed context wire atom<=2048bytes; <=128 outstanding metadata atoms and <=256KiB outstanding payload budget, counted across pending/current encoded frame/partial out until send completion. Original g still enqueues unchanged when metadata budget is exhausted; omission is unknown, never a new dropped feed. No extra queue entries and no g coalescing. Worst extra encoded bytes remain budgeted; release metadata credit on original drop,successful complete send,linkclose or process exit.
risks: Larger frames can increase marshal/decode CPU and socket pressure, change partial-send behavior, and move clock-sensitive windows. Measure; do not assert exact physical equality.
Credit accounting across _encode/_send partial out must not leak or alter original drop/put counts.
If context is absent/budgeted away, causal coverage is unknown. It must not be rescued by nearest-in-time producer logs.

transport_options.name: Parent map keyed by actual batch seq and record ordinal; original g bytes unchanged
transport_options.shape: Parent observer records context keyed (link_epoch,frame_seq,record_ordinal); child adds that ordinal to existing first/last diagnostic. Export map through bounded separate observer output after critical work.
transport_options.fit: Preserves original g wire and frame byte payloads. Avoids additional bytes on market-event socket, but requires parent observer state/export and a new child diagnostic ordinal.
exactness_requirements: The index must reflect the final encoded items sequence: _flush inserts outcomes at outcome_index after _encode; an ordinal captured during pop needs adjustment using actual item reference or assigned only after insert. Do not guess from queue position.

Map needs parent/link/child epoch identity; batchseq and PID alone can repeat after process restart. Exact common process birth identity can be init-only (Linux childPID+PIDnamespace+process-startticks), otherwise external exact deployment/spawn join must prove unique instance or mark unknown. No env credentials.
Existing child frame seq alone is insufficient if repeated identical g records occur in one batch. The exact actual record ordinal must be logged by child without changing learner args.

Parent map cannot know which queued producer event the child will later call first-effective across a start boundary. Retain/export all bounded mapped candidates; if overflowed/expired, mark corresponding joins unavailable.
transport_options.bounds: Proposed128 map entries,256KiB total;64 final records per8KiB chunk only if actual serialized bytes fit,otherwise fewer;<=32 chunks/window/instance. Record max age120s would lose producer->slot joins across a5min preforecast period unless exported before expiry; therefore export bounded mappings at frame completion or use a predeclared >=360s retention with explicit overflow. Never make feed wait for export.
risks: A bounded map can lose exact correlation before slot emission; unknown loss must remain explicit.
Exporting one record per g is forbidden/per-gap overhead; bounded batched chunks still add parent logger work and must have a hard rate/bytes cap with omission counters.

Adding observation bookkeeping inside CPU-budgeted _encode can change frame slicing even with identical g bytes. Put nonessential map finalization after existing encode/send work and measure overhead.
A separate asynchronous writer/sidecar adds lifecycle/failure complexity and is a larger scope; not an implied recommendation.

transport_options.name: Independent context channel/socket
transport_options.shape: Dedicated bounded lossy observer channel for producer+frame mappings; do not insert new records into existing market FIFO.
transport_options.fit: Keeps existing g bytes unchanged and isolates context bytes from market socket, but requires separate transport/lifecycle/export and exact event keys.
risks: Channel reorder/loss/independent backpressure; context may arrive after slot. Never delay learner emission awaiting it or revise old receipts.
If IDs are not carried in g, still needs exact parent(frame_seq,record_ordinal) mapping and child ordinal as above. A hash of identical flags/slugs is not unique.

Sending separate context records on the SAME existing FIFO is not independent: adds queue slots/bytes,changes overflow and can induce sequence failures; reject that variant under strict semantic-preservation scope.
Extra FDs/tasks/processes/threads,logger scheduling and memory expand parent-loop risk and verification scope.

conditional_recommendation.preferred_if_wire_shape_extension_allowe: Optional bounded fifth g context is the smallest exact join, with capability-tolerant old/new decoding and hard outstanding metadata budget. It needs a separately authorized parent/producer observation patch, full equivalence tests, independent money-sensitive review and measured loop/socket overhead.
conditional_recommendation.preferred_if_g_bytes_must_stay_identical: Use bounded parent frame+final-record-index map and child diagnostic ordinal. Explicitly accept incomplete correlation if map/export budget drops context; design common lifecycle identity before claiming unique joins.
conditional_recommendation.not_recommended: Do not infer upstream cause from ws_status strings nearest the target time, replace V1 feed rules now, add a second g event, or silently introduce an asynchronous logger/sidecar.
conditional_recommendation.decision_boundary: Root must choose wire-shape extension versus byte-identical transport requirement. Neither design is approved implementation, a correction of the measured exclusion, or proof of profit/execution improvement.

acceptance_tests: Deterministic paired runs observeroff/on with matched fake clock read sequence: exact existing status dicts/callback order,original g firstfour fields/FIFO order,books/trades/labels,live/practice decisions and serialized state,learner counters/receipts/fingerprint/protocol,save/fsync cadence. No optional metadata affects money code.

Compare sourceproducer fields from actual branch locals: ws maker loss with fresh books vs book freshness loss vs invalidation; transport change; metadata change; REST book/tape error; quiet successful poll; router explicit versus falling-edge injection; simultaneous reasons. Assert observation truth without altering predicates.

Same status tuple repeated within a frame and across frames, several producer callbacks before flush, outcomes inserted before queued events, budget slices/backpressure/partial sends. Join by exact finalized record index, not tuple hash or timestamp proximity.

Produced/received before start but child applied after start; actual current V1 pregap stays unchanged. Recovered status in same or later batch retains first exclusion. Do not reinterpret producer occurrence as effective learner time.
Postforecast/postend gaps, early terms/label termination, late-first-pass, conflicting/out-of-order outcomes. No new historical relabel or extra slot emission.

Producer/router/parent/child restart independently, processPID/frameSeq reuse, old snapshot/pregap, contextwrap, mixed old/new g formats; missing/ambiguous instance -> unknown; no history reconstruction.

Metadata absent,invalidversion,wrong types,bool-as-int,NaN/Inf,oversize strings/tuples,too many window facts,unknown enums,clockreversal/skew/overflow,contexts observed after deadline. Original valid g always applies unchanged; no learner disable or transport failure due optional metadata.

Saturate original PENDING_MAX,contextbudget,reader/socketbudget,partial-out close/crash. Same original put/drop accounting under fakeclock/same socketbehavior; context omitted instead of feed modified; memorycredits never leak; no waits or per-gap logs.

Logging/encoding/carrier/map observers throw before/after write,first event of multi-event batch; one attempted slot cannot duplicate or be backfilled at score. ContextVar token reset under nested callback/task/thread exceptions.

Privacy scan emitted JSON/serialized metadata and sources: no keys,headers,APIpayloads,account/order/position/financial values,unbounded error strings,filepaths or fullstatus snapshots. Only whitelisted public ticker,booleans,age/timing/IDs/hash/enum fields.

Benchmark actual producer callback,router,on_status,arena enqueue/flush and child step at realistic and max gaprates/deepbooks; interleaved observeroff/on wall+CPU,p50/p95/p99/max,allocated/retained bytes,frame/socket bytes,blocked/sliced/dropcounts,eventsize/lograte. Preserve threshold/reasoning before measuring and retain failedruns; no production latency claim from offline benchmark.

proposed_resource_gates_not_yet_validate.logging: No per-gap logs. Keep one child slot summary/window. Any parent-map export separately bounded by bytes,chunk count and rate; saturation means unknown coverage.
proposed_resource_gates_not_yet_validate.parent_hot_path: No network/files/fsync/locks/awaits and no extra resident work. Counter and bounded immutable copy only; preserve existing cancellation/invalidation before nonessential observer work.
proposed_resource_gates_not_yet_validate.clock_tests: Observe added monotonic clocks without replacing existing decision clocks. Cross-process monotonic subtraction only if commonclockdomain proved; otherwise use sameparent monotonic forFIFO and validatedwall forframe/child,or null.
proposed_resource_gates_not_yet_validate.limits: These are prospective design ceilings, not measured passed gates. Addedbytes change pressure; exact real-time equivalence cannot be certified merely by passing fakeclock tests.

open_questions_before_implementation: Whether the next patch may extend g shape (firstfour unchanged) or must preserve every wirebyte.
Which minimum target windows/reasons should receive context when budget saturates; never prioritize by observed outcome.
How parent/link/child lifecycle identity is uniquely joined without environment or account data.
Whether producer predicate ages can be sampled from alreadycomputed locals without adding decisionclock calls or repeating expensive set computations.
Preregister parent-loop overhead/logging/pressure budgets before any implementation benchmark.
no_current_causal_claim: The observed explicit-slug-only V1 exclusion is established by root. Its specific upstream cause remains unknown. This design does not assert quiet trade expiry, a genuine feed disconnect, all-gaps-fixed, a profitable edge, or EXEC completion.
